subject: Compact executive demo — sponsor & contingency plan
messages:
From: Priyanka Shah <pri@aldertech.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Hawkins <tom.hawkins@aldertech.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: AlderTech — executive demo (VP / CIO) — can we compress to 30m?

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the intro last week. We have a narrow exec window on July 12 where our VP of Product (me) and CIO (Tom) can join for 30 minutes only — they prefer a concise, decision-focused walkthrough rather than a full product demo.

Can Redwood run a compact 30-minute briefing focused on: 1) key performance/cost metrics for inference at scale, 2) deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and 3) a short Q&A with our CIO on security controls?

Preferable times (PDT): July 12, 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30. If those don't work, we can aim for July 13 morning.

Also: could you include a short agenda and indicate who from Red wood will be the single exec-facing sponsor?

Appreciate it — Priyanka
Priyanka Shah
VP, Product — AlderTech
Priyanka.Shah@aldertech.com

[Attachment: org-chart-AlderTech.pdf (referenced)]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Priyanka Shah <pri@aldertech.com>
Cc: Tom Hawkins <tom.hawkins@aldertech.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlderTech — executive demo (VP / CIO) — can we compress to 30m?

Hi Priyanka — thanks for the clarity. July 12 works for us; we can do the 10:00–10:30 PDT slot. I'll be the primary sponsor on the call and Ben will run the demo portion; Grace will own the security brief / compliance Q&A.

Draft agenda (attached):
- 00:00–00:03 quick intros and objective framing (Olga)
- 00:03–00:18 focused demo + key metrics (Ben)
- 00:18–00:25 security & deployment controls (Grace)
- 00:25–00:30 decision & next steps (Olga)

I know exec windows are tight — we will rehearse a dry-run tomorrow at 09:00 PDT and keep the deck extremely tight. If the CIO needs deeper technical detail, we'll provide a targeted follow-up with an architecture one-pager.

I've attached the agenda and our internal runbook. I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: AlderTech-exec-agenda-v2.pdf; demo-runbook-olga-20280703.docx

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Priyanka Shah <pri@aldertech.com>, Tom Hawkins <tom.hawkins@aldertech.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlderTech — executive demo (VP / CIO) — can we compress to 30m?

Olga / Grace — noted. I'll trim the demo to a single vertical flow: cold-start latency, 99th pct latency under burst, token cost per 1k with and without prefix caching, and a single deployment recommendation for their compliance needs.

Dry-run plan: tomorrow 09:00 PDT — I'll share a quick recording of the critical demo path (prod-screens-demo.mp4) right after the run so you can vet the timings. Grace, I suggest you prepare a 3-slide security summary focused on data residency, KMS/HSM integration, and audit log retention.

Ben

From: Priyanka Shah <pri@aldertech.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Hawkins <tom.hawkins@aldertech.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlderTech — executive demo (VP / CIO) — can we compress to 30m?

Perfect — 10:00–10:30 on July 12 confirmed. Thanks for being flexible. Two quick asks before the call: 1) please send final agenda and the single slide that covers the recommended deployment (we'll share with our CIO in advance), and 2) could you include a brief note on expected unit cost today versus after batching/quantization (ballpark numbers are fine).

Tom will be on the call and may pose security-specific questions — Grace, look forward to your slide.

I'll accept the calendar invite when it comes through.

—Priyanka

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Priyanka Shah <pri@aldertech.com>
Cc: Tom Hawkins <tom.hawkins@aldertech.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlderTech — executive demo (VP / CIO) — can we compress to 30m?

Thanks — sending the calendar invite now (link in metadata). Attached is the finalized agenda and the single deployment recommendation slide (AlderTech-exec-agenda-v2.pdf). Quick ballpark on unit cost: current per-1k-token avg (hosted small-medium workload) ~ $1.20; with batching + KV caching + int8 quantization, comparable workloads can run ~35–45% lower per-token. We'll include a slide note with assumptions.

Contingency: if Tom needs deeper detail during the 30m, we'll propose a 30-minute follow-up the same week with our Security Architect and an infra lead. If the CIO is unable to join at the last minute, Ben will still run the 30-minute demo and Grace will provide a 3-slide offline security brief.

Looking forward — Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
https://www.redwood.ai | olga_petrov@redwood.ai
